name: transolver_residual
description: Transolver backbone (slice-attention + cross-fidelity attention) trained as a HARD multi-fidelity residual: HF_pred = LF_interp(query) + transolver_delta(query, LF_context, condition). Unlike v9_baseline (soft gated fusion that learns the prior end-to-end) and fno_coreg_residual (FNO+coregionalization), this isolates 'how much does Transolver need to add on top of LF interpolation' which exposes the true delta-learning capacity of the slice-attention backbone.
